mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers a monetary easing cycle that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1000 units triggers a demand slowdown that reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of demand slowdown (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the money supply signals a monetary tightening cycle that reduces economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of monetary tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of labor market slowdown (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP growth rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand growth and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).
